subject: Kaka (Ricardo Izecson dos Santos Leite)
title: Kaka: Ballon d'Or, then Real Madrid

lines.vo: Kaka won the Ballon d'Or in 2007. Then Real Madrid happened.
Twenty-nine goals, thirty-two assists, one hundred twenty games. Roughly a million euros each.
A Spanish radio show put him in its worst-signings top five. One radio opinion.
lines.footage: Real Madrid worst signings debate clip

lines.vo: Then 2013: two yellows in eighteen minutes against Osasuna. Efficient.
But 2007: one thousand forty-seven World Player votes. Messi, five hundred four.
Orlando City reportedly paid him MLS's top salary. Three seasons, no playoffs.
Think you can call the next one? Betting tips, news and predictions at aboutfootball dot UK.

inserts.story: A cartoon club president pushes a wheelbarrow stacked with gold coins toward a caricature of Kaka in a white shirt. Gag: the wheelbarrow tips and coins roll everywhere. Twist: Kaka catches one coin, smiles politely and pockets it.
inserts.characters: generic cartoon club president; caricature of Kaka

inserts.story: A cartoon referee raises a yellow card in front of a caricature of Kaka. Gag: the referee raises a second yellow right after, and a stopwatch behind them shows only 18 minutes. Twist: Kaka checks his wristwatch, nods and strolls off quickly.
inserts.characters: generic cartoon referee; caricature of Kaka

facts_used: Reported 67m euros to Real Madrid in 2009; 29 goals and 32 assists in 120 games (bo pack roast_past)
Radio Marca programme top-5 worst Real Madrid signings: radio debate, not an official ranking (bo pack roast_past, 2025-08-04)
Sent off 12 Jan 2013 vs Osasuna, two yellows in 18 minutes (bo pack roast_past)
FIFA World Player 2007: 1,047 votes vs Messi 504, Ronaldo 426 (bo pack praise)
Orlando City: reported highest-paid MLS player at signing; Orlando missed the playoffs 2015, 2016, 2017 (bo pack roast_past)
notes: Part B: different stories from part A. Non-comic, so no inserts. The 2010 World Cup elbow incident is skipped (conduct dispute, not needed). The 'too perfect' divorce meme is skipped (family). The 'reported' qualifier stays on the transfer fee and the MLS salary. 'Real Madrid happened' is a light joke, not a claim about his career. Punch-up pass: 'about a million euros each' is 67m divided by 61 goal contributions (reported fee; arithmetic gag). 'Reported' stays on the fee and the salary.
